task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC FOR FOUR FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head 60ab6ff; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Verify each claim against the code (cite file:line) and extend the 'Review dispositions (2026-10-10)' list with items 10-13.

10. (P2, ~line 624) 'Persist the selected point across share-link reloads': the selected-system store persists only the id64 (apps/web/src/lib/persistence/stores.ts:107-112), so after a hard reload the separate selected-system contribution has no coordinates when the current page omits the system. Specify ONE of: persist a small point snapshot {id64, name, x, y, z} with the selection (bounded, overwritten on each selection) OR resolve the selected id64 during hydration through a supported exact-system API (name the existing endpoint from apps/api, e.g. the numeric /s/{id64} route or the inspect API — cite it) and only then emit the contribution. Make the E2E reload assertion match the chosen mechanism.

11. (P2, ~line 523) 'Reconcile the 10,000 offset ceiling with selected totals': the URL codec rejects offsets above 10,000 while /api/archetypes/rankings returns an uncapped exact total and accepts larger offsets, so Next would stop while the total says more exist. Choose and specify one consistent rule: either the facade clamps the navigable range to the same 10,000 ceiling and the UI shows 'first 10,000 of TOTAL' with explicit truncation metadata, or the codec permits bounded navigation through the endpoint's advertised range. Keep the earlier requirement that counts and truncation stay synchronized.

12. (P2, ~line 739) 'Enable F4 in the protected Product E2E build': VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED is a build-time import.meta.env value, and .github/workflows/cypress-parity.yml builds with plain `pnpm build`, so the protected Chrome/Firefox lane would never exercise the picker. Add .github/workflows/cypress-parity.yml to the F4b file list with the exact change (set VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED=1 for the E2E bundle build step only) and say explicitly that production/release builds keep the default 0; also note the test-contract files that pin that workflow (grep tests/ for cypress-parity and cite) must be updated in the same PR.

13. (P2, ~line 318) 'Preserve the committed anchor while archetype mode is active': ExploreWorkspace.svelte ~429-434 sets anchor = null as soon as the system-name input is edited, so the promise that returning to Any restores the anchored query cannot hold. Specify a separate committed-anchor state (draft text vs committed anchor) or make the combobox read-only/disabled while an archetype is selected; add the transition to F4b's component tests.

Validation: git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — selection persistence, offset ceiling, E2E build flag, committed anchor'.
